panel: Verify your World of Tanks account to receive the player role and use your in-game nickname on this server.
login_prompt: Use this private link within 10 minutes. Only connect your own account.
success: Account verified. You can return to Discord.
synced: Your player role and World of Tanks nickname are up to date.
unlinked: Your account link and player role have been removed. Your current nickname has been kept.
not_linked: No matching account link was found.
already_linked: This Discord or Wargaming account is already linked. Use /unlink first, or contact an administrator.
invalid_state: This verification link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link in Discord.
wg_error: Wargaming could not verify your account. Please try again later.
discord_error: Discord could not update your role or nickname. Your link is saved. Ask an administrator to check the bot permissions and role hierarchy, then use /resync.
error: The operation could not be completed. Please try again or contact an administrator.
wrong_server: This bot is only available in its configured server.
admin_only: Only server administrators can use this command.
setup_done: The verification panel has been posted.
rejoined: Your player role has been restored. Run /resync in the server to refresh your World of Tanks nickname.
confirm_unlink: Run /unlink confirm:True to remove your player role and account link.
bad_target: Provide exactly one Discord user ID or Wargaming account ID.
not_ready: The bot is starting. Please try again shortly.
